s.headline: Fortnitemares & Override: New Horrors, Sprites, FNAF Bosses
top_changes: New Fortnitemares Islands and Safety in Numbers Quest
Override mode with Sonic, Tetris, Pac-Man inspired areas
Cursed cartridge corrupts BR with new weapons and bosses
Five Nights at Freddy's animatronic bosses at Pizza Parlor
New collectible Sprites with powers; Ranked with abilities off
s.meta_impact: New bosses and mechanics from FNAF and cursed cartridge add horror elements to Battle Royale fights. Sprites introduce collectible powers outside Ranked, shifting strategy toward extraction and leveling. Overrides and themed areas expand exploration and rule-breaking gameplay.

s.headline: Valorant 13.08: Map Pool Swap, Corrode Updates & Map Rating
top_changes: Bind and Corrode added to Competitive and Deathmatch queues
Ascent and Split removed from Competitive and Deathmatch queues
Corrode receives Defender path, Mid, and A Site plant zone changes
New Map Rating system added for Competitive and Premier
Performance Score adjustments for Damage, Kills, Deaths, and Chamber
s.meta_impact: Map pool rotation forces players to adapt to Bind and Corrode while removing Ascent and Split. Faster Corrode rotations and adjusted Mid fights shift defensive and retake strategies. Map Rating adds long-term proficiency tracking that may influence agent and map selection in ranked play.

s.headline: AMD Driver Update Fixes Crashes for 9070 GPUs
top_changes: AMD mainline driver update released
Resolves crashes for 9070 series GPUs in Apex
Players advised to update to latest version
s.meta_impact: This driver fix improves stability for AMD 9070 users, reducing crashes during play. No changes to gameplay or balance. Affected players can now participate more reliably.

s.headline: 26.21: Caitlyn/Jinx nerfs, Azir buffs, ARAM Mayhem
top_changes: Caitlyn passive/Q adjusted, Jinx base stats nerfed
Lee Sin W/R and Nidalee W/E nerfed
Azir mana growth, Ryze Q/W, Sion base/R buffed
Hubris/Greaves nerfed for ranged, Dawncore AP buffed
New ARAM Mayhem 'Journey to Stardom' with augments
buffs: Azir: Mana Growth 40 to 50 per level
Darius: Q cooldown reduced at rank 5
Miss Fortune: E and R damage increased
Ryze: Q flux damage and MS improved
Sion: Health growth and R damage increased
nerfs: Jinx: AD and health growth reduced
Lee Sin: W cooldown increased, R damage reduced
Nidalee: W damage and E AS reduced
s.meta_impact: Nerfs to dominant marksmen Caitlyn/Jinx and junglers Lee Sin/Nidalee/Rammus reduce their presence and open picks for others. Buffs to Azir, Orianna, Ryze, and Sion plus item tweaks encourage mid diversity and shift builds away from ranged Hubris/Greaves abuse. ARAM Mayhem adds new augments and progression for fresh gameplay.
